title: Roof Speakers
summary: On Day two, Wren climbs onto the roof to silence the speakers before the street finds her.

beats.text: My whisper rolled across Port Ellis from forty speakers. Then the street began to climb.
Down the hill, heads turned in the rain. Dozens walked up toward me.
The switch was dead. The speakers ran straight from the mast.
I took wire cutters, a torch and a roll of tape. Nothing else.
Rain hammered the roof. The speaker cable ran along the edge.
I cut it. Forty speakers died at once. The hill fell silent.
Below, the crowd slowed. Stopped. Swayed, like they had lost a song.
Tilly's line had gone quiet too. Then the screen lit: "Wren? Are you still there?"
My dead microphone crackled. A man's voice came through it, live.
"Wren, stop," he whispered. "You cut the wrong one. I am still on the mast."
